related.title: MLPerf HPC：品質門檻與端到端達標時間
related.titleEn: MLPerf HPC: quality gates and end-to-end time to qualification
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：接手者得到6與8且能重建總時間；報告不宣稱未量測的單向分布或實際機器數據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The receiver obtains six and eight and reconstructs elapsed totals without claiming unmeasured one-way distributions or real-machine performance.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「MLPerf HPC：品質門檻與端到端達標時間」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付事件表、checkpoint雜湊、品質曲線、split與seed政策；以可重算的第一次達標判定交接，不提供虛構的MLPerf認證分數。
related.differenceEn: Investigate MLPerf HPC: quality gates and end-to-end time to qualification using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver event tables, checkpoint hashes, quality trajectories, validation-split identity and seed policy. Handover a reproducible first-qualification decision without presenting a fabricated certified MLPerf score.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先以一次往返12微秒畫時間線，得到平均6；再將100次總1200微秒計算，與錯誤1200/100並列，說明兩者分別回答什麼。
畫初始化120、訓練1800、評估60的名義時間線，將0.83綁到最後checkpoint；明列本課把初始化計入，與正式benchmark規則分開。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Draw a single twelve-microsecond round trip to obtain a six-microsecond half-trip average. Extend the reasoning to one hundred trips totaling 1200 microseconds, and contrast division by one hundred with division by two hundred without conflating the resulting quantities.

Draw the baseline sequence of initialization, training and evaluation and bind the 0.83 quality result to its final checkpoint. Explicitly include initialization under this engineering contract while keeping official benchmark timing rules as a separate review item.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: LEONARDO：跨分區工作流的產物就緒契約
related.titleEn: LEONARDO: artifact readiness across heterogeneous partitions
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：接手者得到6與8且能重建總時間；報告不宣稱未量測的單向分布或實際機器數據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The receiver obtains six and eight and reconstructs elapsed totals without claiming unmeasured one-way distributions or real-machine performance.
related.difference: 產物清單包含大小、雜湊、格式版本、單位與 ready 狀態；求解器僅能讀取完整驗證且版本相容的產物。
related.differenceEn: Define a manifest with size, hash, format version, physical units and ready status. The solver may consume only an artifact whose validation has completed and whose format contract matches the requested executable.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先以一次往返12微秒畫時間線，得到平均6；再將100次總1200微秒計算，與錯誤1200/100並列，說明兩者分別回答什麼。
此串行模型的關鍵路徑為前處理時間加傳輸時間加求解時間；資料驗證已包含在前處理，不能再假設未宣告的重疊；前處理 120 秒、求解 60 秒、產物 40 GB；有效傳輸率由 2 改為 1 GB/s；名義式 120+40/2+60 = 200 s；變更式 120+40/1+60 = 220 s。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Draw a single twelve-microsecond round trip to obtain a six-microsecond half-trip average. Extend the reasoning to one hundred trips totaling 1200 microseconds, and contrast division by one hundred with division by two hundred without conflating the resulting quantities.

In this serial model, the critical path adds preprocessing, transfer and solve times. Validation is included in preprocessing, and undeclared overlap is not permitted when computing the promised completion time. Preprocessing takes 120 seconds, solving takes 60 seconds and the artifact is 40 decimal GB. Effective transfer rate changes from 2 to 1 GB/s; these are synthetic end-to-end rates, not interconnect specifications. Nominal 120+40/2+60 = 200 s; changed 120+40/1+60 = 220 s. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
